messages.subject: csv and gtx processing- inconsistent results
parts:
Hi all, 
I'm new to GGIR and have been experimenting with processing different file types csv and gtx. I ran GGIR to process a .gtx file and the equivalent .csv file and found that the results were inconsistent between the two. See the attached example comparing outputs.

Could anyone shed some light on some possible reasons I'm getting these inconsistencies? 

Thank-you in advance,
Brendan

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: csv and gtx processing- inconsistent results
parts:
Hi Brendan,

I think that what you see is expected and it is not related to GGIR. There are minor differences on how actilife stores de accelerations in the gt3x and the csv files, especially if the idle sleep mode was activated during the data collection. When using gt3x files, GGIR takes care of the time gap imputation, but in the csv files, the data are already imputed by the manufacturer and then minor differences are to be expected.

Best,
Jairo
